# Epistole

> Sovereign Rust newsletter service for fleet web properties.

Epistole replaces hosted newsletter forms with an axum service that owns subscribe, confirm, unsubscribe, archive, and operator send flows. Storage is embedded fjall; rendering uses maud; delivery goes through a configured SMTP relay.

## Binary

`epistole` - service binary built from `src/main.rs`. It loads config, opens the fjall store, and serves the HTTP routes.

## Architecture

Structured LLM corpus:
- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): service layers and interfaces
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): phase, recent work, and active threads
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): accepted service decisions
- [_llm/glossary.toml](_llm/glossary.toml): newsletter vocabulary
- [_llm/apis.toml](_llm/apis.toml): CLI and HTTP routes

## Agent Entry Points

- [README.md](README.md): service purpose and phase plan
- [DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md): deployment runbook
- [src/lib.rs](src/lib.rs): router, middleware, and route registration
- [src/store.rs](src/store.rs): fjall persistence
- [src/token.rs](src/token.rs): confirm and unsubscribe token contract
